cohort: Full OKX NY weeks in the common archive; first post-Monday touch of each side using the monitor's unrounded levels. Include both directions. Require two adjacent strict inside closes; neither the confirmation nor its four-hour label may pass the weekly reset.
factor: Second close strictly above touch-bar high (lower touch) or below touch-bar low (upper touch), versus two inside closes without breaking that extreme. No threshold sweep.
primary_outcome: At exactly 4h after the second close, is price strictly further inward than that second close? Ties count as no. This is a directional price label, with no entries, projected trading returns or fees.
inference: Report 2024-25 and 2026 separately, each asset and both, both directions as diagnostics. Resample complete NY week clusters within each period including zero-event weeks. A positive group difference with a lower bound above zero in 2026 and positive data in both assets is evidence for prospective follow-up only. No trading decision.
